question: What did the teacher identify as the abode of universal bliss?
premises: There is a reality of unstruck awareness nourished by supreme nectar.
The teacher declared that reality to be the abode of universal bliss.
This identification is presented as authoritative.
inference: Therefore the abode of universal bliss is unstruck awareness nourished by supreme nectar, as taught by the guru.
plain_english: Our teacher declared that very reality—unstruck awareness nourished by supreme nectar—to be the abode of universal bliss.
